disclaimer: This is an automated pre-audit readiness report. It is not a formal audit, does not prove the absence or presence of vulnerabilities, does not authorize live-target testing, and should only be used on repositories you own or are authorized to review. A formal audit is recommended before handling real user funds.

historical_patterns.broken_invariant_class: Share/accounting value cannot be moved by transient price state.
defensive_checks: Document oracle freshness, bounds, and fallback behavior.
Test deposit, withdraw, and totalAssets under mocked stale and bounded prices.
Prefer TWAP, sanity bounds, or explicit staleness checks where the design depends on external prices.
historical_patterns.failed_assumption_class: Price source remains representative during deposits, withdrawals, and share conversions.
historical_patterns.name: Harvest/Yearn-style oracle or pool price readiness gap
historical_patterns.suggested_test: Invariant: share price and totalAssets cannot be inflated by a single mocked price or pool-state movement.
historical_patterns.why_it_matters: Vault accounting that depends on oracle, pool, LP, or reserve pricing needs explicit tests for stale, spot, and manipulated local price assumptions.

historical_patterns.broken_invariant_class: Deposits, withdrawals, redemptions, and fee paths conserve value within expected rounding bounds.
defensive_checks: Add deposit-withdraw roundtrip tests across small and large amounts.
Test donation, zero-supply, rounding, and fee paths.
historical_patterns.failed_assumption_class: Shares and assets remain exchangeable according to documented accounting rules.
historical_patterns.name: Vault accounting invariant readiness gap
historical_patterns.suggested_test: Invariant: deposit followed by withdraw does not create value and does not strand assets beyond expected rounding.
historical_patterns.why_it_matters: Vaults need explicit conservation and roundtrip properties because share math, fees, donations, and rounding can break user-value assumptions.

historical_patterns.broken_invariant_class: Strategy lifecycle events cannot silently break totalAssets, share price, or withdrawal accounting.
defensive_checks: Test harvest/report gain and loss paths with local mocks.
Test strategy withdrawal and migration accounting.
Document trusted strategy roles and loss-handling assumptions.
historical_patterns.failed_assumption_class: Strategy-reported balances, gains, losses, and debt remain aligned with vault accounting.
historical_patterns.name: Strategy debt/gain/loss accounting readiness gap
historical_patterns.suggested_test: Invariant: strategy gain/loss reports update totalAssets and share accounting according to documented policy.
historical_patterns.why_it_matters: Strategy vaults need explicit tests for gain, loss, debt, harvest, report, and migration lifecycle assumptions.

historical_patterns.broken_invariant_class: Withdrawal lifecycle preserves shares/assets accounting and available liquidity assumptions.
defensive_checks: Test request, cancel, claim, cooldown, and epoch transitions.
Test available liquidity and buffer boundaries.
Document delayed withdrawal assumptions for auditors.
historical_patterns.failed_assumption_class: Requested, pending, claimable, and cancelled withdrawals move through documented states only.
historical_patterns.name: Withdrawal liquidity and queue lifecycle readiness gap
historical_patterns.suggested_test: Test: withdrawal lifecycle conserves shares and assets across request, cooldown, claim, and cancellation.
historical_patterns.why_it_matters: Withdrawal queues, cooldowns, epochs, and liquidity buffers need lifecycle tests because user exits depend on state transitions over time.

historical_patterns.broken_invariant_class: Emergency and configuration changes preserve the user-facing safety properties the protocol claims.
defensive_checks: Test unauthorized calls for each setter and emergency function.
Test pause and emergency controls against deposit, withdraw, redeem, and strategy paths.
Document trusted-role powers and operational limits.
historical_patterns.failed_assumption_class: Privileged operations are limited to documented roles and cannot bypass accounting assumptions silently.
historical_patterns.name: Privileged vault controls and emergency operation readiness gap
historical_patterns.suggested_test: Invariant: admin operations cannot bypass vault accounting without explicit, documented trust assumptions.
historical_patterns.why_it_matters: Vault admin operations can change strategy, oracle, fee, limits, slippage, pause state, or upgrade targets and should be tested as launch-critical boundaries.

historical_patterns.broken_invariant_class: Value flow remains single-entry and accounting is updated before control leaves the contract.
defensive_checks: Add reentrancy tests using local receiver mocks.
Use guards where the protocol design requires them.
historical_patterns.failed_assumption_class: External receivers cannot re-enter before internal accounting reaches a safe state.
historical_patterns.name: Reentrancy-sensitive value flow review recommended
historical_patterns.suggested_test: Test: malicious local receiver cannot withdraw, claim, or redeem twice through a callback.
historical_patterns.why_it_matters: External calls around withdrawals, claims, callbacks, or token transfers have repeatedly exposed state-ordering assumptions.

historical_patterns.broken_invariant_class: Admin actions cannot silently bypass accounting, oracle, or user-safety invariants.
defensive_checks: Document every privileged role and setter.
Add unauthorized-call tests for each privileged function.
Add tests showing pause/emergency controls behave as documented.
historical_patterns.failed_assumption_class: Privileged actors can only perform documented, intended operations.
historical_patterns.name: Privileged control and operational risk review recommended
historical_patterns.suggested_test: Invariant: unprivileged callers cannot change fees, oracles, strategies, treasury, pause state, or upgrade target.
historical_patterns.why_it_matters: Admin setters, emergency controls, fee updates, and governance execution paths can become launch blockers if role boundaries are unclear or untested.

next_steps: Add Foundry invariant tests for accounting, roles, and value-flow boundaries.
Document and test oracle freshness, decimals normalization, bounds, and fallback behavior.
Add deposit/withdraw roundtrip, totalAssets consistency, and donation/inflation-resistance tests.
Add convertToShares/convertToAssets rounding tests and preview/action equivalence checks for ERC4626-like flows.
Add local mock strategy tests for gain, loss, debt, harvest, and migration accounting.

readiness_gaps.detail: Vault/ERC4626-like accounting signals were detected, but no non-placeholder invariant/property testing signal was found.
readiness_gaps.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to historical vault/accounting failure classes where broken share valuation or manipulated accounting state caused loss.
readiness_gaps.recommendation: Add Foundry invariants for share/accounting conservation across deposit, withdraw, donation, fee, and emergency scenarios.
readiness_gaps.suggested_test: Add a Foundry invariant that checks totalAssets and share accounting conservation across deposit, withdraw, donation, and fee scenarios.
readiness_gaps.title: Vault accounting without invariant tests
readiness_gaps.why_it_matters: Vault bugs often appear when shares, assets, totalSupply, totalAssets, and external balances drift from assumptions used during deposits and withdrawals.

readiness_gaps.detail: Preview function signals were detected, but test files do not visibly cover previewDeposit, previewMint, previewWithdraw, or previewRedeem.
readiness_gaps.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to share/accounting mismatch classes where quoted and realized vault state diverge.
readiness_gaps.recommendation: Add tests that preview functions match actual state-changing outcomes within documented rounding bounds.
readiness_gaps.suggested_test: For each preview function, compare the previewed shares/assets with the actual deposit, mint, withdraw, or redeem result.
readiness_gaps.title: ERC4626-like interface without preview function tests
readiness_gaps.why_it_matters: ERC4626 integrations often rely on preview functions for quotes and UX; inconsistent previews can create user and integration risk.

readiness_gaps.detail: Shares/assets conversion signals were detected without visible decimals, precision, mulDiv, or rounding test coverage.
readiness_gaps.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to historical arithmetic and accounting mismatch classes where precision assumptions failed.
readiness_gaps.recommendation: Add tests for rounding direction, small values, decimals mismatch, and conversion reversibility.
readiness_gaps.suggested_test: Fuzz assets and shares across small, large, and decimal-edge values and assert conversion error stays within documented bounds.
readiness_gaps.title: Shares/assets conversion without rounding tests
readiness_gaps.why_it_matters: Small rounding mistakes in conversion functions can compound into unfair share issuance, redemption drift, or stranded assets.

readiness_gaps.detail: totalAssets appears connected to external strategy, pricing, or balance assumptions without visible manipulation-resistance test coverage.
readiness_gaps.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to Harvest/Yearn-style vault readiness classes where pricing or strategy state influenced share accounting.
readiness_gaps.recommendation: Test totalAssets under donated assets, mocked strategy gain/loss, and mocked stale or bounded pricing where relevant.
readiness_gaps.suggested_test: Mock external strategy or price state and assert totalAssets, share price, and withdrawal accounting remain within documented policy.
readiness_gaps.title: totalAssets external dependency without manipulation-resistance tests
readiness_gaps.why_it_matters: Vault share value often depends on totalAssets; external balances, strategies, or prices can make the accounting view drift from user expectations.

readiness_gaps.detail: Strategy, harvest, debt, gain, loss, or migration signals were detected without visible strategy lifecycle tests.
readiness_gaps.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to strategy debt/gain/loss accounting readiness classes.
readiness_gaps.recommendation: Add tests for strategy report, harvest, gain, loss, debt changes, withdrawals, and migration or emergency exit if present.
readiness_gaps.suggested_test: Use a local mock strategy that reports gain and loss, then assert totalAssets and share accounting follow documented policy.
readiness_gaps.title: Strategy accounting without gain/loss tests
readiness_gaps.why_it_matters: Strategy vaults can look solvent until gain/loss, debt, or migration paths update accounting in unexpected ways.

readiness_gaps.detail: Withdrawal queue, cooldown, epoch, pending withdrawal, or liquidity-buffer signals were detected without visible lifecycle tests.
readiness_gaps.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to vault lifecycle readiness classes where exit accounting or liquidity assumptions can break.
readiness_gaps.recommendation: Add tests for request, cooldown/epoch movement, claim, cancellation, and insufficient-liquidity behavior.
readiness_gaps.suggested_test: Test the full withdrawal lifecycle and assert shares/assets are conserved across request, cooldown, claim, and cancellation.
readiness_gaps.title: Withdrawal queue/cooldown without lifecycle tests
readiness_gaps.why_it_matters: Delayed withdrawals create state machines; audit preparation should prove shares and assets are conserved through each state.

readiness_gaps.detail: Oracle, price-feed, pool-price, reserve, TWAP, or LP pricing signals were detected without enough stale-price, bounds, or sanity-check coverage.
readiness_gaps.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to historical vault/oracle and pool-price manipulation readiness classes.
readiness_gaps.recommendation: Add local mock price tests for stale rounds, decimals normalization, price bounds, and fallback behavior.
readiness_gaps.suggested_test: Use local mock oracles/pools to test stale, out-of-bounds, decimals, and spot-price scenarios without live-chain calls.
readiness_gaps.title: Oracle-dependent vault without stale-price or bounds tests
readiness_gaps.why_it_matters: Vaults that price assets, LP tokens, or strategies through external sources need explicit assumptions around stale, spot, and bounded prices.

readiness_gaps.detail: Fee terms were detected without visible tests for fee accounting, recipient balances, or conservation around fee paths.
readiness_gaps.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to accounting mismatch classes where protocol fees changed conservation assumptions.
readiness_gaps.recommendation: Add deposit, withdrawal, management, and performance fee tests where relevant.
readiness_gaps.suggested_test: Assert user shares, treasury shares/assets, and totalAssets remain consistent before and after fee-bearing operations.
readiness_gaps.title: Fee logic without fee accounting tests
readiness_gaps.why_it_matters: Fee logic changes share issuance, redemption value, and treasury balances; missing tests make audit review slower and riskier.

readiness_gaps.detail: Pause or emergency signals were detected without visible tests for blocked flows and documented recovery behavior.
readiness_gaps.historical_pattern_similarity: Maps to operational readiness classes where emergency behavior changes core state transitions.
readiness_gaps.recommendation: Add tests showing pause/emergency controls block risky flows and preserve documented exit or recovery paths.
readiness_gaps.suggested_test: Assert pause and emergency states block or allow each vault flow exactly as documented.
readiness_gaps.title: Pause/emergency controls without operational tests
readiness_gaps.why_it_matters: Emergency controls are launch-critical; they should behave predictably under stress without bypassing accounting assumptions.

suggested_invariants.description: totalAssets should match local asset accounting and strategy balances within documented rounding.
suggested_invariants.name: totalAssets consistency

suggested_invariants.description: A user should not create value by depositing and withdrawing through normal paths.
suggested_invariants.name: deposit/withdraw roundtrip

suggested_invariants.description: Conversion functions should be mutually consistent within documented rounding across supply states.
suggested_invariants.name: convertToShares/convertToAssets consistency

suggested_invariants.description: Donations, low supply, and external balances should not let one actor distort share value unexpectedly.
suggested_invariants.name: share price donation resistance

suggested_invariants.description: Fees should be bounded, documented, and unable to overcharge beyond configured limits.
suggested_invariants.name: fee accounting conservation

suggested_invariants.description: Strategy gains, losses, and withdrawals should remain reflected in accounting assumptions.
suggested_invariants.name: strategy balance drift handling

suggested_invariants.description: Queued or delayed withdrawals should conserve shares/assets through request, cooldown, claim, and cancellation.
suggested_invariants.name: withdrawal lifecycle conservation

suggested_invariants.description: Pause should block risky flows while preserving documented emergency exits.
suggested_invariants.name: pause behavior

suggested_invariants.description: Stale oracle rounds should be rejected or handled according to documented policy.
suggested_invariants.name: stale price rejection

suggested_invariants.description: Price decimals should be normalized consistently before accounting decisions.
suggested_invariants.name: decimals normalization

suggested_invariants.description: Outlier prices should hit documented bounds or review paths.
suggested_invariants.name: price bounds

suggested_invariants.description: Spot price dependence should be bounded by TWAP, sanity checks, or explicit assumptions.
suggested_invariants.name: TWAP or sanity check

suggested_invariants.description: Only authorized roles should change oracle configuration.
suggested_invariants.name: oracle update access control

suggested_invariants.description: Unauthorized users cannot call privileged setters or emergency functions.
suggested_invariants.name: unauthorized role rejection

suggested_invariants.description: Owner/admin operations cannot silently break accounting invariants unless explicitly trusted and documented.
suggested_invariants.name: admin cannot bypass accounting

suggested_invariants.description: Pause blocks documented risky flows and preserves expected recovery paths.
suggested_invariants.name: pause blocks risky flows

suggested_invariants.description: Upgrade authorization works as intended and cannot be triggered by untrusted callers.
suggested_invariants.name: upgrade authorization
